name: TF7 Ultra Smart Watch | Metal Body, AMOLED Display, Bluetooth Calling, Fitness & Health Tracker
description:
The TF7 Ultra Smart Watch combines modern style with powerful features in a durable metal body. Its vibrant AMOLED display delivers crystal-clear visuals, while advanced health monitoring keeps track of heart rate, blood pressure, SpO₂, and sleep. With fitness tracking, Bluetooth calling, and smart notifications, this watch ensures you stay active, connected, and in control all day.
Key Features
 1.9” AMOLED high-definition display
 Full health monitoring: heart, BP, SpO₂ & sleep
 Multi-sport activity tracking with calories & steps
 Bluetooth calling & instant smart notifications
 Music control & weather updates
 Strong battery life with efficient performance
Ingredients / Materials
Metal alloy case, silicone strap, AMOLED display, precision sensors
How to Use
 Charge fully before first use
 Connect to phone via Bluetooth & compatible app
 Enable call, notification & health features
 Wear daily for fitness, work & lifestyle tracking
Package Includes
 1 × TF7 Ultra Smart Watch
 1 × Magnetic Charging Cable
 1 × User Manual
